question_type: multi-issue time-series assembly (4 pinned September issues x 5 fiscal years) + statistic (R-square) rounded to 4 dp
decisive_step: Read 'Use bulletins from September 1996, 2001, 2006 and 2011' as: each named issue supplies its own five completed fiscal years (1991-95, 1996-2000, 2001-05, 2006-10) from the on-budget / off-budget receipts columns (FFO-1 cols (2)/(3), or equivalently FFO-2 cols (45)/(46)), excluding the 'Est.' and 'to date' rows, and do NOT apply the latest-printing rule across later issues. The reference made this call in worklog Step 0 ('vintage choice is dictated by the question') and confirmed it in Step 4 ('5+5+5+5 = 20 years, exactly FY1991-2010, no overlap'); sources are treasury_bulletin_1996_09.txt:473-477, 2001_09:543-547, 2006_09:580-584, 2011_09:508-512.

a.path_summary: find_tables led to FFO-2 first (a[6]); two pages of the 1996_09 FFO-2 continuation did not surface the total on/off-budget columns (a[15]-a[19]), so it re-searched with 'total receipts' and switched to FFO-1 (a[21]-a[25]). It then listed FFO-1 cols 1-3 for the three later September issues (a[33], a[37], a[38]), took the first five fiscal-year rows of each, and computed corrcoef squared with calc (a[41]).

first_divergence.what_it_did: Decided that the question names the issues, so the named bulletins override the latest-printing rule; used each issue's own 5-year block.

tool_use.friction: a[11] rg on bare corpus filenames failed (files are not in cwd; only the table tools resolve bare names); a[28] zsh 'set -- $spec' does not word-split, three show_table calls errored 'invalid int value'; a[30] re-used FFO-2 line numbers for FFO-1 by mistake (one wasted 3-table call); a[33] three tables chained in one command hit the 8,000-byte page so only the 2011 table survived; a[35] --grep with a regex alternation '1996|1997|1998|1999|2000' matched 0 rows (grep is a plain substring, not a regex), forcing per-issue --from-row 0 calls (a[37], a[38]); a[9]/a[13]/a[32] for-loops over years show only the last iteration in the digest (probably output clipping, worth checking).

a.text_use: a[26]: 'AGENTS says ... unless question names publication date use latest. Here question names bulletins, so use those' (table note 1); a[41] used calc for the final number.

b.path_summary: find_tables gave FFO-2 (b[6]); a guessed line landed on UST-1 (b[8]); after find_tables --years 1996 --all (b[12]) it read the FFO-2 parts with --stitch and found the Total receipts On-budget (45) / Off-budget (46) columns in the continuation (b[15]). It pulled those two columns for 2001_09, 2006_09 and 2011_09 with --stitch --cols (b[20]-b[27], with three re-runs because --cols 12-15 missed the on-budget column), listed all 20 pairs (b[28]), computed R-square two ways with calc (b[30]) and submitted; the gate recorded it with no findings (b[32]).

first_divergence.what_it_did: Assumed each named September issue contributes its own 5-year block and used FFO-2's total on/off-budget columns.
first_divergence.what_a_right_cell_or_the_reference_did: Reference used FFO-1 as primary and FFO-2 as a cross-check; b's FFO-2 FY1999 on-budget cell differs from FFO-1 by a tiny fraction of a percent (reference worklog Step 7) and does not change the 4-decimal result.

notes: 1) FFO-1 col (2) and FFO-2 col (45) disagree for FY1999 in 2001_09 (reference worklog Step 7); a/c used FFO-1, b/b2 used FFO-2, both round to the same 4 decimals. A cheap tool feature: when printings or show_table sees the same series in two tables of one issue, print 'differs from FFO-1 col (2) at line 546' so the model can pick the internally consistent one (FFO-1 rows satisfy on+off=total). 2) find_tables --years lists the latest issues first and shows only 3 parts per group; every cell needed --all plus grep for the September file to get line numbers - a '--issue 1996_09' filter would replace the for-loops (a[9], a[13], b[18]). 3) The 8,000-byte page is the main cost driver: a and c paid 2-3 extra calls per issue. 4) The v8_analysis link (per-question/012.json) does not exist on disk (that folder only holds v8 failures); pilot1_analysis is null. 5) b2's plain show_table returned empty output (verified in events.jsonl item_14) - check cli.py's default view.
